exams.name: Praxis Elementary Education: Teaching Reading (7002)
exams.blurb: Reading instruction subtest of the 7001 battery, aligned to the science of reading and required in several states for elementary licensure.

exams.name: Praxis Elementary Education: Three Subject Bundle (5901)
exams.blurb: Bundle of mathematics, social studies and science subtests for candidates who have already met the reading requirement separately.

exams.name: Praxis Interdisciplinary Early Childhood Education (5023)
exams.blurb: Test for teachers of young children with and without disabilities from birth through primary grades, spanning intervention and family services.

exams.name: Praxis Pre-Kindergarten Education (5531)
exams.blurb: Licensure test for pre-kindergarten teachers covering child development, play-based learning, assessment and family partnership.

exams.name: Praxis STEM for the Elementary Grades (5036)
exams.blurb: Test for elementary STEM endorsement covering integrated science, technology, engineering and mathematics instruction.

exams.name: Praxis Teaching Reading: Elementary (5205)
exams.blurb: Standalone reading instruction test for kindergarten through grade six teachers, covering foundational skills, comprehension and assessment.

exams.name: Praxis Teaching Reading: K-12 (5206)
exams.blurb: Reading instruction test spanning kindergarten through grade twelve, including adolescent literacy and disciplinary reading.

exams.name: ETS Major Field Test
exams.blurb: Outcomes assessments measuring undergraduate and graduate mastery of a discipline, used by programmes for accreditation and benchmarking.

exams.name: ProEthica Professional Ethics for Educators
exams.blurb: Online ethics training and assessment for educators, covering professional conduct, boundaries and decision making in schools.

exams.name: Praxis Art: Content and Analysis (5135)
exams.blurb: Visual art licensure test combining content questions with constructed-response analysis of artworks and instructional scenarios.

exams.name: Praxis Art: Content Knowledge (5134)
exams.blurb: Selected-response visual art test covering art history, criticism, aesthetics, media, techniques and studio production.

exams.name: Praxis Citizenship Education: Content Knowledge (5087)
exams.blurb: Content test covering civics, government, history and economics for teachers of citizenship education courses.

exams.name: Praxis Economics (5911)
exams.blurb: Content test for economics teachers covering microeconomics, macroeconomics, international trade and personal finance.

exams.name: Praxis English Language Arts: Content and Analysis (5039)
exams.blurb: English licensure test adding constructed-response literary and rhetorical analysis to the selected-response content knowledge questions.

exams.name: Praxis English Language Arts: Content Knowledge (5038)
exams.blurb: Secondary English content test covering reading of literature and informational texts, language use, writing, speaking and listening.

exams.name: Praxis Geography (5921)
exams.blurb: Content test for geography teachers covering physical and human geography, regions, spatial analysis and geographic tools.

exams.name: Praxis Government/Political Science (5931)
exams.blurb: Content test covering United States government, comparative politics, international relations and political theory for civics teachers.

exams.name: Praxis Journalism (5224)
exams.blurb: Content test for journalism teachers and advisers, covering reporting, editing, media law, ethics and student publication management.

exams.name: Praxis Music: Content and Instruction (5114)
exams.blurb: Music licensure test pairing content questions with constructed-response tasks on rehearsal planning and instructional decisions.

exams.name: Praxis Music: Content Knowledge (5113)
exams.blurb: Core music education test covering theory, history, performance, listening analysis and music pedagogy for school music teachers.

exams.name: Praxis Music: Instrumental and General Knowledge (5115)
exams.blurb: Music test emphasising instrumental teaching, ensemble direction and general music content for band and orchestra candidates.

exams.name: Praxis Music: Vocal and General Knowledge (5116)
exams.blurb: Music test emphasising choral and vocal teaching alongside general music content for candidates seeking vocal music licensure.

exams.name: Praxis Psychology (5391)
exams.blurb: Content test for high school psychology teachers covering biological bases, learning, development, disorders and research methods.

exams.name: Praxis Social Studies (5581)
exams.blurb: Current secondary social studies licensure test that replaced Content Knowledge 5081, covering history, civics, geography and economics.

exams.name: Praxis Social Studies: Content and Interpretation (5086)
exams.blurb: Social studies test adding constructed-response source interpretation and argumentation to selected-response content questions.

exams.name: Praxis Sociology (5952)
exams.blurb: Content test for sociology teachers covering culture, socialisation, social institutions, stratification and research methods.

exams.name: Praxis Speech and Theatre (5222)
exams.blurb: Combined content test for candidates licensed to teach both speech communication and theatre arts in secondary schools.

exams.name: Praxis Speech Communication: Content Knowledge (5221)
exams.blurb: Content test covering rhetoric, public speaking, interpersonal and group communication, media literacy and forensics coaching.

exams.name: Praxis Theatre (5641)
exams.blurb: Theatre licensure test covering acting, directing, design, technical theatre, dramatic literature and theatre history.

exams.name: Praxis World and U.S. History: Content Knowledge (5941)
exams.blurb: History licensure test covering world history from ancient to modern periods alongside United States history and historical methods.
